suggestions.title: Self-test pins the live registry status of specific cases, so a routine status change turns the CI check job red
suggestions.evidence:
Several self-test cases drive real registry entries without --force or expect a refusal, so they depend on those entries keeping their current status:
- Line 751, 'a stale case needs --force': vp(['drive','stop-button','--dry-run']), expecting /is stale/.
- search/search without --force at lines 413, 490, 649, 737 and 744. Line 649 expects exit 1 from doctor.
- glass-journeys/create-task without --force at lines 311, 322, 329, 597, 606 and 614.
- failed-send/restart-combo at lines 198, 205, 212 and 736.
- review-modal/empty-review at line 479.
- providers-tabs/claude-bin-detection at line 698.

In vp.mjs:203-213 the force refusal (exit 2) comes before the needsArgs refusal and before doctor, so a status flip changes both the exit code and the message these cases match. The ci.yml step runs right after install and before Spec parse, chromium install, Drizzle checks and Typecheck.
suggestions.failurePath:
Example 1: a later PR fixes drive-stop.mjs and sets stop-button/stop-chain to current, which is the kind of registry update the PR leaves to case owners or the P6 gardener. vp then gets past the force check and refuses on needsArgs ('needs arguments', exit 2). The /is stale/ match at line 752 fails, so the self-test reads 50/51 and exits 1.

Example 2: a UI change makes a PR mark search/search stale. Five cases fail. Line 649 gets exit 2 instead of 1, and lines 413, 490, 737 and 744 get the refusal instead of the dry-run output.

In both examples vp.mjs behaves correctly, and the required check job stops at this step. Spec parse, typecheck and the drizzle checks give no signal for that PR until someone edits the self-test.

Suggested fix: run these cases against fakeSkill entries (status and needs set by the test), the way the real-llm and stale+forced-need cases already do. Reserve the real registry for the whole-registry scans.

suggestions.title: Following AGENTS.md's squash procedure would land the first commit's outdated message
suggestions.failurePath: AGENTS.md:70 tells the merger to take the squash subject and body from `gh api repos/xiechimon/pacman/pulls/1411/commits -q '.[0].commit.message'`. For this PR that is 4ab0d89's message. Its subject is 'verify(1402): vp.mjs single entry and drive registry', with no (#1411). Its body has round-1 counts: 64 features, 102 cases, 10 support scripts, and 29 features without a recipe. The registry at the head has 66 features, 106 cases, 11 support scripts and 31 features without a recipe. A merger who follows the documented procedure literally puts those wrong numbers into main's history. The PR body's Issues section gives a corrected squash message (no closing keyword, trailers present). Whoever merges has to use that message, not `.[0]`. No ticket is closed wrongly either way, because neither message has a closing keyword.
suggestions.evidence: git log -1 --format=%B 4ab0d89: 'vp-registry.json registers every script under scripts/: 64 features, 102 cases, 10 support scripts ... 29 features have probes but no features/ file'. The registry at the head counts 66 features, 106 cases, 11 support scripts and 31 null recipes.

suggestions.title: Code comments describe past behavior, which pr-pacman's plain-writing rules forbid
suggestions.failurePath: pr-pacman SKILL.md lines 33-37 say to describe only the current state and not to write that something 'used to be' something else. They also say the same rules apply to code comments. vp.mjs:200-202 reads: 'a stale case's refusal used to name only its status, and --force then also let its real-llm, github or rewrites-evidence need through unnamed (pr-gate run 7 on #1411)'. vp-selftest.mjs:527-529 and 758-759 tell the same kind of history. These comments stay in the skill after merge and describe code that no longer exists. This is style only and changes no behavior.

suggestions.title: Ticket's static-gate acceptance item and gate-misfire failure mode are untested; the ticked box is a deferral
suggestions.evidence: Ticket #1402 lists 'new drive-\d+ script turns the static gate red, existing scripts stay green' as an acceptance item and 'static gate misfires on non-drive scripts such as doctor.mjs' as a failure mode. At head, no CI step or self-test case checks either one. The PR body ticks '[x] Ticket items that segment 2 carries ...' for them. Acceptance item 2 is also reworded from 'using only --help and the feature map' to 'driven through vp.mjs', and features/*.md have no `vp.mjs drive` lines yet. The PR's Risk section says a script added under scripts/ without a registry entry passes this self-test.
suggestions.failurePath: A new scripts/drive-1500-x.mjs lands on main, as drive-1400-chip-word.mjs and drive-search-project-line.mjs did while this PR was open. vp-selftest.mjs still reads 51/51 and CI stays green, so the ticket's static-gate item has no evidence at this head. This is acceptable only because #1402 stays open and the squash message has no closing keyword. Leaving those two boxes unticked, or wording them as not done, would keep the pr-evidence reading honest.

suggestions.title: Self-test cases depend on the live registry status of stop-button and search, so a correct registry change can turn CI red
suggestions.evidence: Two kinds of case read real registry entries. 'a stale case needs --force' (vp-selftest.mjs:749-753) runs `drive stop-button --dry-run` and expects /is stale/. Six cases (:413, :490, :649, :737, :744) drive `search search` without --force and expect it to run. For the real-llm case the self-test already uses a fakeSkill stub, because no registry case needs real-llm.
suggestions.failurePath: A case owner or the P6 gardener (as the PR's Risk section invites) fixes stop-chain and marks stop-button/stop-chain `current`. That case keeps `needsArgs`, so `vp.mjs drive stop-button --dry-run` now exits 2 with 'needs arguments: <todoId>...' instead of 'is stale', and 'a stale case needs --force' goes red. In the other direction, a product PR that removes a class the search probe waits on marks search/search `stale`, as happened to glass-journeys/board after #1375. The five `--dry-run` cases then exit 2 at the --force refusal and fail. 'a failed doctor leaves no evidence directory behind' (:649) also fails, because it is refused before doctor runs and so exits 2 instead of 1. Pinning these cases to fakeSkill stubs would keep them independent of registry state.

suggestions.title: Failure mode 'vp.mjs path and direct script reach different verdicts' is covered only by a four-regex static check
suggestions.evidence: PRE_FIX_DEFAULTS (vp-selftest.mjs:150-155) matches four spellings of a probe that defaults to its pre-fix mode. Other cases check vp's dispatch only through --dry-run output. No case checks that a registered case's default args reach the same mode a probe's documented direct command reaches. I scanned every registered probe for argv-based mode switches at head, and all current cases already default to post-fix mode. The PR's Risk section acknowledges the gap.
suggestions.failurePath: Someone registers a new probe written as `const MODE = process.argv.includes('--fixed') ? 'fixed' : 'baseline'` with `args: []`. The self-test stays green. On a healthy stack, `vp.mjs drive <feature>` runs the baseline mode and goes red, while the recipe's `node drive-x.mjs --fixed` passes. That is the ticket's 'same feature, two paths, different conclusions' failure, with no test to catch it.

suggestions.title: drive writes into an existing VERIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR without refusing, including committed docs/verify directories
suggestions.evidence: Only `archive` enforces add-only (vp.mjs:420). When VERIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR is set, `drive` runs `mkdirSync(named, { recursive: true })` and passes that directory to the probe whether or not it already holds files. freshDir is used only when the variable is unset. No self-test case covers a named directory that already exists. The Verified section itself sets VERIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR by hand (`VERIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR=.claude/verify-evidence/20261020-restart-combo vp.mjs drive ...`).
suggestions.failurePath: `VERIFY_EVIDENCE_DIR=docs/verify/1402/20261020-203718-api-key node .claude/skills/verify-pacman/scripts/vp.mjs drive api-keys create` runs drive.mjs with that directory. drive.mjs rewrites the committed 01-keys-empty.png, 02-keys-create-dialog.png, 03-keys-once.png and result.json in place, against ADR 0015's add-only rule for docs/verify. The ticket names this failure mode for archive only, so it is not blocking. A refusal when the named directory resolves under docs/verify/, or is non-empty, would close it, with a self-test case to pin it.

suggestions.title: Committed screenshots show the full plaintext of two API keys from scratch stacks
suggestions.failurePath: The api-key probe screenshots the one-time key reveal. `docs/verify/1402/20261020-203718-api-key/03-keys-once.png` shows the whole key `pacman_74f2b5a84c11b5fce298dabbd0ff182f7cb7f4f737c43ba8`, and `docs/verify/1402/20261020-233153-api-keys-create/03-keys-once.png` shows a second key (`pacman_1bc74fe2…`). Once merged, both are readable by anyone through raw.githubusercontent.com, because the repo is public. The PR says both keys were minted on scratch stacks whose homes `vp.mjs cleanup` deleted. Nothing in the diff can verify that: the `result.json` files show only that `homeDir` was under a worktree's `.claude/verify-run`. So the claim that the keys authenticate nothing rests on the author's word. Main already has five earlier `03-keys-once.png` files (344, 354, 425, xmon-20, 1166), so this repeats an existing practice. It is not a traced live-credential leak. Suggested fix: blur the key line in these two PNGs, or have the api-key probe mask the reveal before the screenshot, so the pattern stops spreading into evidence that is add-only and permanent.
suggestions.evidence: Viewed 03-keys-once.png at the head: the reveal card shows the full 48-hex-character key. result.json in both dirs holds only the masked key and its keyHash. homeDir is /home/user/pacman/.claude/worktrees/p1/.claude/verify-run/home.
